name: Anime Vanguards
tagline: Latest working Anime Vanguards codes for free trait rerolls, gems, gold and memoria shards.
description: Anime Vanguards is a Roblox tower-defense game developed by Kitawari, where players summon anime-inspired units to defend against waves of enemies across colliding worlds. Released in late 2024 and currently on Update 12+, it has rapidly become the leading anime tower-defense experience on Roblox, absorbing much of the audience that previously played Anime Adventures. Codes are released around major updates and milestone events, granting free trait rerolls, gems, gold, memoria shards, and flowers — all useful for stacking before opening a unit banner. Every code listed here has been cross-referenced against major aggregators (Pocket Tactics, Pro Game Guides, Beebom) and the Anime Vanguards Fandom wiki, and is refreshed as new codes drop or old ones expire.
longDescription:
Anime Vanguards is the most successful anime-inspired tower-defense game on Roblox. Built by Kitawari and launched in late 2024, it grew explosively in early 2025 as the previous genre leader, Anime Adventures, lost momentum. Today it sits comfortably in the Roblox top-charts during every update cycle, with hundreds of thousands of concurrent players on weekend nights.

The core loop is a triangle of summoning units (the in-game version of gacha-pulling characters), placing them on a tower-defense map, and upgrading both individual unit traits and your account-level Mastery tree. Codes are the cheapest way to refill the three resources that bottleneck this loop: **Trait Rerolls** (used to reroll a unit's randomly-rolled passive trait), **Gems** (the soft pull currency), and **Memoria Shards** (an evolution material). Codes can also drop **Gold**, **Flowers** (event currency), and occasionally **Rainbow / Green Essence Stones** for higher-tier rerolls.

The code release pattern is unusually disciplined for a Roblox game: most active codes have a soft expiry of around two weeks, and the development team typically issues a 'code freeze' in the days leading up to a major update. As of mid-2026, the most recent batch landed alongside Version 9.0, including the level-30-gated `Liberation` and `DMCAFree`. Players new to the game should clear the campaign to account level 30 first before redeeming the heaviest codes — many of the high-reward drops are level-gated and will not pay out otherwise.

whatCodesDo:
Anime Vanguards codes drop one of six reward types, each tied to a specific bottleneck in the unit progression loop. **Trait Rerolls** are the most coveted: each one lets you reroll a unit's passive trait (the random buff rolled when a unit is summoned), and a high-rarity Mythic or Vanguard unit needs dozens of rerolls before landing a meta-defining trait like Solar or Range. Save rerolls until you have actually summoned the unit you want to optimise.

**Memoria Shards** are the evolution currency — you need 100 to 500 of them to evolve a Mythic unit into its higher-tier form. Bank them; do not fragment them across two units you might evolve later. **Gems** are the soft summon currency and the most generally useful: 2,000 gems is roughly one ten-pull on a featured banner. **Gold** is the upgrade currency for placed units mid-map; it is the easiest resource to earn naturally, so code-granted gold is mostly relief for new accounts.

**Flowers** are event-window currency, used in the in-game shop to buy specific event units and cosmetics — codes only drop them during active events. Finally, **Essence Stones** (Green / Rainbow) are higher-tier reroll materials introduced in version 9.0; they let you reroll while preserving certain traits, which is a meaningful efficiency gain on Mythic-tier units.
whereToFindMore: New Anime Vanguards codes are announced first on the official [Kitawari Twitter / X](https://twitter.com/KitawariRBLX) account, usually within minutes of going live. The [official Discord server](https://discord.gg/animevanguards) follows with a confirmation post; partnered creators (Aphmau gaming squad, Mr. Skeleton, and the official Kitawari devstream) often produce showcase videos within an hour. The Anime Vanguards Fandom wiki maintains a community-edited code list, but it lags the Twitter account by an hour or two and occasionally lists expired codes as still-active. We refresh this page within 24 hours of any new code announcement; bookmark the [latest codes view](/anime-vanguards/latest) for the cleanest list.
releaseCadence: Anime Vanguards has the most predictable code release calendar of any active Roblox game we cover. **Major updates** (every six to eight weeks) ship with three to five new codes, all roughly two-week expiries. **Milestone events** — visit count, favourites, anniversary — drop one to two single-reward codes each. **Partnered creator livestreams** rarely produce permanent codes; most are tied to that stream's two-week window. The development team has openly committed to a 'code freeze' window in the lead-up to each major update — they pause new code drops while finalising the update build, so a long gap (sometimes three weeks) between codes usually signals an update is imminent rather than that the team has gone quiet. As of mid-2026, the current freeze suggests the next major update batch is due within the next 14 to 21 days.
expiredCodesContext: Anime Vanguards codes have one of the shortest active windows among the games we cover — roughly two weeks from drop to expiry. The codes archived below all expired in the past three to six months, almost all rotated out alongside the next major update. We keep the archive live so returning players can quickly confirm a code they saw in an old YouTube thumbnail or Discord screenshot is genuinely dead before wasting time retyping it, and so the addition / expiry date columns document Kitawari's release cadence at a glance. The archive also makes our active list verifiable — every retired code on this site lived in the archive before being moved.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Anime Vanguards on Roblox
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox on your platform of choice and start an Anime Vanguards session. You will land in the main lobby — the code redemption flow is accessible from there once the UI finishes loading. If you have an unfinished match in a private server, the codes flow still works there, though some level-gated codes will not pay out until you hit the required Mastery level.

redeemSteps.title: Open the Profile menu
redeemSteps.detail: Tap the Profile icon on the right-hand side of the screen. The Codes redeem entry moved here from the Settings menu in a UI refresh during early 2026 — older YouTube tutorials still pointing at the gear icon are out of date and will leave you searching the wrong menu. The Profile icon is the small head silhouette in the right-side icon column.

redeemSteps.title: Tap the Codes icon inside Profile
redeemSteps.detail: On the profile panel that slides in, tap the Codes icon on the left side. This opens a single-line text input box plus a Redeem Code button. The box does not have a paste shortcut on PC — you need to right-click and select Paste, or use Ctrl+V after focusing the box.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code character-for-character
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page using the Copy button next to it, then paste it into the in-game text box. Codes are case-sensitive — `BumBum` and `bumbum` are not the same — and several codes include digits or special characters that are easy to mistype. Always copy-paste rather than retyping. The text box does not auto-correct but does trim trailing spaces.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Redeem Code and check your inventory
redeemSteps.detail: Press the green Redeem Code button. A confirmation message appears on success. If the code is rejected, the most common cause is that your account level is below the gate — most version 9.0 codes require Mastery level 30. Trait Rerolls, Memoria Shards, and Gems arrive instantly in your inventory; check the corresponding counter on the lobby UI to confirm.

troubleshooting.cause: The code has expired (two-week soft expiry on most codes), or you mistyped a character — especially capital letters and digits.
troubleshooting.fix: Cross-check against our [Expired Codes archive](/anime-vanguards/expired). If it is not there, copy-paste it directly from our Active table — we verify every entry within 24 hours of release.

troubleshooting.cause: The code is account-level gated. Several version 9.0 codes (Liberation, DMCAFree, 223, Cog5th) require Mastery level 30 to actually pay out.
troubleshooting.fix: Keep grinding to level 30. The code itself is consumed but the reward is held; once you cross the level threshold the reward drops into your inventory automatically. Check our notes column for the level gate on each code.

troubleshooting.cause: Each code is one-time per Roblox account. You cannot redeem the same code twice on the same account.
troubleshooting.fix: Move on to the next code. If you genuinely never redeemed it on this account, the in-game logic is rarely wrong — check whether you redeemed it on the same Roblox account but a different display name.

troubleshooting.symptom: Code box does not respond to Paste
troubleshooting.cause: On PC, the Roblox text input requires a right-click → Paste rather than Ctrl+V on first interaction.
troubleshooting.fix: Right-click the text box and select Paste from the context menu. Alternatively click into the box first to focus it, then press Ctrl+V.

troubleshooting.symptom: I cannot find the Codes icon at all
troubleshooting.cause: Old YouTube tutorials still point at the gear / Settings icon, but the redeem flow moved to the Profile menu in early 2026.
troubleshooting.fix: Tap the head-silhouette Profile icon on the right side of the screen, not the gear. The Codes icon is on the left side of the Profile panel.

faq.question: How often are new Anime Vanguards codes released?
faq.answer: New codes drop in three windows: major updates (every six to eight weeks, three to five codes per batch), milestone events (visit / favourite counts, one to two codes each), and partnered-creator livestreams. The development team also runs a 'code freeze' window in the days before each major update — long gaps between codes usually signal an update is imminent rather than the team having gone quiet. As of mid-2026, expect the next batch alongside the upcoming update.

faq.question: Why is my Anime Vanguards code not working?
faq.answer: The three most common reasons are case-sensitivity ('BumBum' is not 'bumbum'), expiry (most codes only last about two weeks from release), and account-level gates — several version 9.0 codes require Mastery level 30 and will show 'requirement not met' until you reach it. If you copy-pasted directly from our Active list and it still fails, it has almost certainly just expired.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code twice on different accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Each Roblox account can redeem a given Anime Vanguards code once. A code already used on your main can still be redeemed on an alt, though rerolls and shards do not transfer between accounts.

faq.question: What's the best time to use trait rerolls and memoria shards from codes?
faq.answer: Save trait rerolls until you have summoned the unit you actually want to optimise — rerolling on a placeholder Rare unit wastes the rolls and the trait pool is unit-tier-locked. Memoria shards are best banked until you have a clear evolution target so you do not fragment the resource across multiple units. The single highest-leverage use is rolling traits on a Mythic-tier unit you have just pulled and intend to keep on your main team.

faq.question: Are Anime Vanguards codes level-gated?
faq.answer: Some are. The version 9.0 batch (Liberation, DMCAFree, 223, Cog5th) require Mastery level 30 and will redeem but hold the reward until you cross the level threshold. Older codes are generally not level-gated. Our notes column on each code lists any level requirements.

faq.question: Do Anime Vanguards codes work on mobile and Xbox?
faq.answer: Yes. The redemption logic runs on the Roblox server, not the client, so codes work identically on every platform that supports Roblox — PC, mobile, Xbox, and the Roblox web player. Only the position of the Profile and Codes icons on screen differs slightly between platforms.

faq.question: Can I get banned for using Anime Vanguards codes?
faq.answer: No. Codes are an official feature built directly into the Profile menu by Kitawari, the developer. The only way you can get banned around code use is by sharing or selling Roblox account credentials, which violates the Roblox Terms of Service regardless of whether codes are involved.

faq.question: What is the most valuable Anime Vanguards code I can redeem right now?
faq.answer: For accounts at Mastery level 30 or above, `DMCAFree` is currently the single most valuable active code, granting 1,500 trait rerolls in one drop — enough to take a Mythic unit from a baseline trait to a top-tier one. After that, `Liberation` (50 Memoria Shards + 5 Rainbow Essence Stones) is the second priority for any account close to an evolution unlock.
